answer: Sustained Pulse Ledger.** Each identity must emit a periodic pulse at irregular, unpredictable intervals; credit accrues only at the vertex where a pulse lands within its narrow window, and missed or early pulses reset the streak. To sustain N identities an attacker must staff constant, timing-accurate attention across every identity, paying continuous labor cost plus penalties for each lapse. Casual clones lose their terrace of accumulated credit and must rebuild from zero.
